$comment: Sound beds for meditations. These are SYNTHESIS DESCRIPTORS, not file paths: the demo builds each bed in the browser with OscillatorNode and filtered noise rather than shipping audio. That removes the licensing question entirely (PDR 5.7 makes bed_tracks.license mandatory) and keeps the repository small. When a real audio library replaces this, the shape stays: name, frequency_hz, and a selection hint the model can reason over.
$safety: None of these are binaural beats. Binaural beats present two different frequencies, one per ear, and are contraindicated in epilepsy - using them would require adding a question to the clinical onboarding screen, which is out of scope. Every bed here is a single tone, or a chord of tones, played identically to both ears, plus filtered noise.
